Pause charging the battery while the tablet is hot

While charging, if the battery reaches the threshold temperature and is charged to at least the minimum charge, the battery stops charging and the charger powers the tablet directly, so the battery does not heat up further. Charging resumes when the temperature or the charge falls below them. It switches at most once every 5 minutes.
The battery is at %1$s. The charger powers the tablet directly until it cools down, then charging resumes.
